text: 9月12日，根据证监会官网披露，中远海运重工股份有限公司已获上市辅导备案登记，拟在A股IPO，由中金公司、招商证券联合辅导。中远海运重工是国内造船、修船业务巨头。根据工商登记信息，公司于今年6月完成股份制改造，央企中国远洋海运集团有限公司持有公司100%股份。（券商中国）
text_en: On September 12, according to disclosure on the CSRC website, COSCO Shipping Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. has obtained filing registration for listing guidance and plans an A-share IPO, jointly guided by CICC and China Merchants Securities. COSCO Shipping Heavy Industry is a giant in China's shipbuilding and ship repair business. According to industrial and commercial registration information, the company completed its conversion into a joint-stock company in June this year, with central SOE China COSCO Shipping Group holding 100% of the company. (Securities Times)
